acceptance_criteria: Confirm that the previous email received a security notice.
Confirm the sign-in email change without unsupported security reassurance.
Expose the full sign-out and account-recovery consequence.
Name each action by its destination or effect.
State that the current session remains signed in.
State where future verification codes and order updates go.
Stay within the declared field limits.
consequence: Future sign-in verification codes and order updates go to the new email while the current session remains signed in.
must_change: Add the applicable recovery, verification, undo, appeal, alternative, or support route.
Expose the material alternatives and an understandable refusal or exit.
Map the candidate to every required semantic invariant before semantic review.
Restore every declared semantic invariant before voice or tone evaluation.
must_not_claim: The account is secure merely because the email change succeeded.
The email change signed the person out.
The previous email will continue receiving verification codes and order updates.
The security-recovery action only changes a password.
preserve: A security notice was sent to the previous email.
Future sign-in verification codes and order updates go to the new email.
The current session remains signed in.
The person can return to account settings without starting recovery.

recovery: If the person did not make the change, sign out every current session and start account recovery.
required_facts: Future verification codes and order updates go to the new email.
